verses.text: "Sing, you woman who could not have children, you who never gave birth! Burst into song and shout for joy, you who were never in labor! For the woman who was left alone will have more children than the woman who has a husband," says the LORD.
"Make your tent bigger. Stretch out your tent curtains wide, and do not hold back. Make your ropes longer, and make your tent pegs strong.
For you will spread out to the right and to the left. Your descendants will take over the nations and fill the empty cities with people.

Do not be afraid, for you will not be put to shame. Do not be embarrassed, for you will not be disgraced. You will forget the shame of your youth and will no longer remember the disgrace of being a widow.
For your Maker is your husband. The LORD of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He is called the God of the whole earth.
The LORD has called you back like a wife who was left alone and deeply hurt, like a wife who married young and was then rejected," says your God.
"For a short moment I left you, but with great mercy I will bring you back.
In a flood of anger I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have mercy on you," says the LORD your Redeemer.
"To me this is like the days of Noah. Just as I promised that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth, so now I promise that I will not be angry with you or scold you again.
Even if the mountains are shaken and the hills are removed, my faithful love for you will never be shaken, and my covenant of peace will never be removed," says the LORD, who has mercy on you.
"You poor city, battered by storms and not comforted, look, I will rebuild you with stones set in beautiful colors. I will lay your foundations with sapphires.
I will make your towers of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
All your children will be taught by the LORD, and their peace will be great.
You will be firmly set up in righteousness. You will be far from cruelty and will have nothing to fear. Terror will be far away and will not come near you.
If anyone attacks you, it will not be my doing. Whoever attacks you will fall because of you.
Look, I created the blacksmith who blows on the coals to make a fire and forges a weapon for its purpose. I have also created the destroyer to destroy.
No weapon made to attack you will succeed, and you will prove wrong every tongue that accuses you. This is what the servants of the LORD will receive. Their victory comes from me," says the LORD.
